sentences.japanese: いつも柳の下に泥鰌は居らぬ。
sentences.english: A fox is not caught twice in the same snare.

sentences.japanese: あいつにはまいったよ。どんなに厳しく怒っても、柳に風と受け流すだけだよ。
sentences.english: I don't know what to do with that guy. No matter how mad I get at him he just takes it in stride and pays no attention.
Oaks may fall when reeds stand the storm.
A fox isn't caught twice in the same snare.

sentences.japanese: 花火のフィナーレを飾った「しだれ柳」は、夜空に華やかに舞い上がり、緩やかな弧を描きながらゆっくりと垂れ下がって、やがてその可憐な姿を消していった。
sentences.english: The Firework's displays final "Weeping Willow" display brilliantly launched into the night sky, slowly dripping down as it drew a gentle slope until finally its blossoming figure gradually vanished.
